observations: Single photo shows a cream/beige upholstered sofa with a curved, ribbed-texture armrest design.
Sofa sits on a tiled floor with a patterned rug partially visible and a small potted plant beside it.
Watermark reads 'KENN PETERS' across the image.
No measuring tape, tag, or brand marking visible anywhere on the item.
Only one angle is shown; no close-up of fabric texture, seams, or underside/legs.

claims.evidence: No purchase date, receipt, or wear timeline visible in photo 0; condition cannot be aged from a single static image.
No tape measure, ruler, or reference object of known size is in photo 0 to confirm length.

risks.risk: Actual dimensions (length/width/depth) unknown, affects whether it's a loveseat or full sofa
risks.proof: Photo with a tape measure laid along the length, or the sofa next to a known-size object (door, person)
risks.if_unproven: priced as smallest plausible size for stated type (compact loveseat)

risks.risk: Fabric condition — stains, discoloration, or wear not visible from this single angle/lighting
risks.proof: Close-up photos of seat cushions, armrests, and back in bright natural light, plus a shot of any tags
risks.if_unproven: priced as having visible wear/staining (worst case)

risks.risk: Frame and spring integrity (sagging, broken frame) cannot be assessed from a photo
risks.proof: Video of someone sitting on it showing no sag/creak, or photo of underside frame
risks.if_unproven: priced as structurally uncertain / possible sagging

risks.risk: Odor or stains from pets/smoking not visible in photo
risks.proof: Seller's written disclosure plus close-up of cushion undersides and seams

risks.risk: Color may appear different in person due to lighting/photo filter
risks.proof: Photo taken in natural daylight without filter/watermark overlay
risks.if_unproven: priced at lower end for color-mismatch risk

proof_requests: Clear daylight photos from multiple angles (front, side, back) without watermark obstruction
Close-up shots of any stains, tears, or discoloration on cushions and armrests
A tape measure shot showing actual length and depth
Photo of the underside/legs and frame joints
Any original purchase receipt or product tag photo to support '3 months used' claim
response.reason: The item is clearly a used fabric sofa/loveseat identifiable by type, but both seller claims (age and size) are unverifiable from the single photo, so it must be priced at worst-case condition and smallest plausible size until better proof is supplied.
